content: ). [SWS_ComM_01029] DRAFT If ComMDynamicPncToChannelMappingEnabled is set to TRUE and function ComM_Nm_RepeatMessageLeftIndication has been called ComM shall set the PNC Learning Phase to inactive for the according channel.

If ComMDynamicPncToChannelMappingSupport is set to TRUE on at least one channel and when the PNC learning phase is not active, then the function ComM_PnLearningRequest shall call the API Nm_PnLearningRequest on all channels where Specification of Communication Manager AUTOSAR CP R22 - 11 110 of 193 Document ID 79 : AUTOSAR_SWS_COMManager ComMDynamicPncToChannelMappingEnabled is set to TRUE and return with E_OK.
